definitions.explanation: A feeling of opposition or animosity toward someone, often manifesting as a desire to resist or confront them.

examples.japanese: {敵対心|てきたいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{敵対心|てきたいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いていた→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
examples.english: He harbored hostility from the first meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{敵対心|てきたいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}った→歩み寄る：13197_ayumiyoru⟧。
examples.english: In order to ease the other person's hostility, I made the first move to reach out.

notes:
Describes feelings of opposition or animosity directed at a specific person or group. Unlike general anger, {敵対心|てきたいしん} implies viewing the other party as an adversary. The word combines ⟦{敵対|てきたい}→敵対：12914_tekitai⟧ (opposition; hostility) with {心|しん} (mind; feeling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敵対心|てきたいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor hostility
- {敵対心|てきたいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧: to burn with hostility
- {敵対心|てきたいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to openly display hostility
- {敵対心|てきたいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧: to ease hostility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敵意|てきい}→敵意：16853_tekii⟧: hostility; enmity — more concise and commonly used; slightly stronger nuance
- ⟦{対抗心|たいこうしん}→対抗心：15178_taikoushin⟧: competitive spirit; rivalry — focuses on wanting to compete rather than viewing someone as an enemy
- ⟦{反感|はんかん}→反感：08675_hankan⟧: antipathy; aversion — a broader dislike that may not involve seeing someone as an adversary
- ⟦{憎悪|ぞうお}→憎悪：04865_zouo⟧: hatred — stronger than {敵対心|てきたいしん}; implies deep-seated loathing
